name: dead dogs :3
source:
You wake on your ex’s couch. You shouldn’t be here. This world isn’t yours. He may want you, but he has never needed you. You are just a wandering puppy.

[From [url=https://magpuppy.itch.io/dead-dogs-web]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在前任的沙發上醒來。你不該在這裡。這個世界不屬於你。他也許想要你，卻從來都沒需要過你。你只是一隻四處流浪的小狗。

［摘自[url=https://magpuppy.itch.io/dead-dogs-web]Itch.io[/url]］
